rendered: In the table of lithium-ion diffusivities (Table 5[1]), the aluminium-based coating with the highest Li-ion diffusivity is Li3.5Al2 O3 (am)[2], with a diffusivity of 7.1 ×10^− 10[3] cm^2/s at 300[4] K. Amorphous Al2O3 is listed as 5.94 ×10^− 17[5] cm^2/s at the same temperature. The lithiated amorphous coating is therefore faster by 7[6] orders of magnitude than amorphous Al2O3. The other aluminium compounds in the table (Li0.2Al2O3, LiAlO2, and the amorphous and crystalline AlF3 entries) all have lower values than Li3.5Al2O3.
